title: Multi-agent tasks: which coding agent
how_to_use: For task class X use classes.X.first_choice; if it cannot run right now (plan limit reached, engine unavailable), take the next entry in fallbacks. For coding and agentic work, use classes.X.subclasses.Y instead when the task is clearly kind Y.

method.evidence_rule: An unproven entry (no own jobs) ranks above a proven one only if its priority is more than 0.03 higher and its public_norm is higher.
method.harness_rule: A public metric measured in another agent's harness counts at 0.8x (norm multiplied). The engine's own harness, or a model-only benchmark (no harness or a neutral one), counts in full.
method.subclasses: Coding and agentic subclasses are ranked the same way, on the public metrics that measure that kind of work and own jobs of that kind; a subclass with neither is not listed.
method.limits: Plan limits are checked live when a job is dispatched; this table does not track them.

status_meanings.proven: ranked with own jobs from the last 28 days
status_meanings.unproven: public scores only, no own jobs yet
